1.0.0.title: What's new in Cora 1.0
items: A new look: sidebar, Home, ⌘K to search and run anything, and each meeting as one page with Notes, Transcript and Action items. Try it in Settings › Try the new look; the classic look is one click away.
Live captions in Hinglish, on this Mac: turn them on in Settings › Processing & models. Captions keep up about a second behind, and nothing leaves your Mac.
Captions no longer put the other side's words in your mouth when you use speakers instead of headphones.
Notion: Cora suggests a Task (or a link to an existing one) for each action item, with the right assignee; nothing is sent until you Confirm. Setup guide in Settings › Connections.
Zoom in the browser is detected again, with everyone's names.
Request a feature or star Cora on GitHub from the sidebar or Settings › Help & feedback.
